whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bihari Thaath,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.1★ reviews with over 440 ratings in Bihta near IIT Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online orders and table bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order booking, special menu showcase, aur operating hours integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/biharithaath

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Bihari Thaath, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your popular authentic Bihari menu showcase opposite IIT Patna in Bihta. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
